description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the ClientReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve client data in various ways within the Fineract project. It includes database query logic, data mapping, validation, and external service references, primarily focusing on reading client information from the database.

classes.name: ClientMembersOfGroupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping database rows to ClientData objects for group members.

classes.name: ParentGroupsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping query results to GroupGeneralData objects representing parent groups.

classes.name: ClientLookupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping client lookup query results to simplified ClientData objects.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for retrieving client data by identifier.

classes.name: ClientToDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping comprehensive client database result set to ClientData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of clients based on search parameters, with options for sorting and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific client by ID, including collateral and group info.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Fetches a list of clients suitable for lookup purposes based on extra SQL criteria.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookupByOfficeId
methods.description: Retrieves clients belonging to a specific office for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveClientMembersOfGroup
methods.description: Gets members of a specific group, considering the hierarchy of the current user.

methods.name: retrieveActiveClientMembersOfCenter
methods.description: Fetches active clients who are members of a particular center.

methods.name: retrieveClientByIdentifier
methods.description: Finds a client based on a specific identifier type and key.

methods.name: retrieveAllNarrations
methods.description: Returns a template with client narrations and options.

methods.name: retrieveClientTransferProposalDate
methods.description: Gets the proposed transfer date for a client, if any.

methods.name: retrieveUserClients
methods.description: Retrieves client IDs associated with a specific user.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdByExternalId
methods.description: Finds the internal client ID corresponding to an external identifier.
